description:
Use this to answer 'what would my monthly payment be' for ONE listing. It runs the same itemized
out-the-door calculation as estimate_out_the_door (always treated as financed) and turns it into a DEMO monthly
finance payment: out-the-door total minus down payment and trade equity, amortized at the APR (or a demo APR
by credit_tier) over term_months. Returns finance.estimated_monthly_payment rounded to $5, monthly_payment_range,
amount_financed_estimate, total_of_payments, finance_charge and every assumption, plus the out-the-door figure
it used, a one-line assumptions_summary and any dealer-advertised payment shown separately (not comparable unless
the terms match). To compare several scenarios for this car in one call, use compare_payment_scenarios.
Use get_price_breakdown instead for the dealer's listed price and fees only, and estimate_out_the_door for
the full itemized total without a payment. To find cars by payment across many listings, use search_inventory
with max_monthly_payment (same as payment_max). Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Not penny-accurate. Leases are not modeled.

apr.description: APR percent, 0 to 36. If omitted, a demo APR is picked by credit_tier.
apr.title: Apr

buyer_city.description: Buyer's city, for local tax lines.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_county.description: Buyer's county without 'County', for local tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state, or the state of buyer_zip.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's five-digit ZIP. Here it sets buyer state and city when buyer_state is omitted.
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

credit_tier.description: excellent, good (default), fair or poor. Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted (used and cpo rates are higher than new).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

down_payment.description: Cash down in USD, subtracted from the out-the-door total. Default 0.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives from get_price_breakdown that the buyer qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD (negative equity is added to the amount financed).
payoff.title: Payoff

term_months.description: Loan term in months, 12 to 96. Default 60.
term_months.title: Term Months

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity in USD when allowance and payoff are unknown (negative if upside down). Subtracted after tax, so no trade-in tax credit is applied.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD. Passed to the out-the-door step, so it gets the state's trade-in tax credit where allowed.
trade_value.title: Trade Value

name: get_payment_estimate
